_readme: S748 lane 1 (keys): San Jose City College, four program pages, free, no model call, nothing written: Graphic Design A.A. 41533, User Experience and Interaction Design A.S. 42682, Motion Graphic Design A.S. 44388 and Liberal Arts: Arts & Humanities A.A. 18449. The state's Program Course File names fourteen courses of these programs by the cut-off subject name 'ComputerGrap' where a code belongs, and the state's course list names one of them DMA 1 and leaves thirteen unnamed; the 2026-2027 catalog prints each under CGID and a number. S742's read (46006600029) printed the CGID lines and its text is not committed. This plan prints each page's table rows that name a CGID or DMA course, with the title and units beside it (rows), so each printed code is paired with the state's row by the one title both print; and, on 18449's page, the rows that print the 18 units over its two lists ('Complete 18 units from courses listed below', the Theory-based and Non-Theory-based headings) and the totals. 18449's page is last, so its rows sit nearest the end of the log.

questions.cgid_lines: Which row prints each CGID course, with which title and units, and how does 18449's page print the 18 units over its two lists?
